questions.passage:
A notice on a museum's website was widely shared by readers who admired a newly repaired clock. Most assumed it was a report about the object itself. In fact, the notice invited people to apply for a restoration post. The person chosen would spend part of each week repairing clocks and the rest showing visitors how the mechanisms worked.

Until recently applicants had to submit two examples of earlier repairs. The museum now asks for twice that number, as it wants to see whether candidates have worked with a range of objects.
questions.q: The word “post” in Paragraph 1 refers to
o: a report about a repaired clock.
an opening at the local museum.
a notice shared on the website.
a public display of clock parts.
questions.answer_support: the notice invited people to apply for a restoration post
questions.target: 职位 post 与网络帖子、文章的区别
questions.skill: 职位 post 与网络帖子、文章的区别

exp.trans: 流传的网页公告其实是招募钟表修复人员。录取者需做修复并为访客讲解。往年提供两个修复实例，今年要四个。
exp.structure: apply for 的宾语 post 是人可以申请的职务。后一段用 twice that number 回指以前的两个实例。
exp.other: restoration 修复，vacancy 职位空缺，opening 在求职语境也是职位空缺。
exp.meaning: 修复和讲解是被录用者的工作。公告是发布渠道，post 在此表示其中提到的工作岗位。
exp.rest: 关于钟表的报道是读者以为的内容。网上公告发布了岗位信息。展示部件属于工作中的活动。

questions.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
questions.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
questions.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

questions.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
questions.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

questions.passage:
A community radio station would repeat its morning news in the evening if it were not for a long-standing agreement with a local music school. The agreement gives the school the use of that slot for student concerts.

The station has put recordings of the news on its website, but some listeners have asked whether they could hear it on the radio. Moving the news to a later slot would keep the concerts on the air, though it would be too late for many listeners.
questions.q: Which statement best describes the present situation at the station?
o: The news has been moved to a later slot on the radio.
The school can no longer broadcast its student concerts.
The station no longer makes its morning news available.
The school still has the slot needed for a news repeat.
questions.answer_support: The agreement gives the school the use of that slot for student concerts
questions.target: 区分现实许可与假设结果
questions.skill: 区分现实许可与假设结果

exp.trans: 社区电台本想晚上重播晨间新闻，但该时段依协议用于学生音乐会。新闻已有网播录音，晚一点的电台时段对许多听众来说太迟。
exp.structure: would repeat 是假设结果。if it were not for 后接当前协议这个障碍。第二句给出协议仍允许学校使用时段的事实。
exp.other: slot 播出时段，long-standing 长期存在的，on the air 正在播出。
exp.meaning: 学校仍可使用同一时段，这项现实许可使新闻无法在该时段重播。
exp.rest: 晚些播只是设想。晚间音乐会仍可播出。电台已把晨间新闻放上网站。

questions.target: these breaks 及图表中的缺口
questions.skill: 用相邻句寻找同义回指
questions.passage: The figures in a local wage survey were collected each summer from 1970 until 1990. Four years are missing because the survey forms were lost before the results could be recorded. Early charts drew a single line across the missing years, creating the impression of steady changes for which no evidence existed. When the figures were republished, the editors left gaps in the line at the relevant dates. These breaks warn readers against treating the line as a continuous record.
o: Changes in the wages reported by employers.
Intervals between the dates of publication.
Periods when employment fell in the area.
Spaces in the chart where data are missing.
questions.answer_support: the editors left gaps in the line at the relevant dates

exp.trans: 当地工资调查有四年的表格丢失。早先的图表跨过这些年份直接连线，营造了变化连续的印象。重发数据时，编辑在对应位置把线断开，提醒读者这些年份缺少记录。
exp.structure: 数据遗失导致年份缺失。编辑用断开的线表示缺失，下一句用 These breaks 重提图上这些缺口，并说明它们的作用。
exp.meaning: breaks 在这里指连续线条的断开处。these 指向前一句已经明确出现的 gaps。
exp.rest: 工资变化、两次出版的间隔和就业下滑都是不同事件。图表断线标明没有记录，这些空白本身不足以推出任何工资或就业变化。

questions.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

questions.passage:
A coastal town promised to reopen its footbridge by September. When the work fell behind schedule, residents criticised the delay but welcomed a separate campaign to make the river walk easier to follow. Over several weeks volunteers handed out maps, put directions outside the station and led short guided walks.

The opening date attracted most of the newspaper coverage. Visitor surveys suggest it was the quieter effort to explain how to reach the river that helped people find the route.
o: a promise to open the footbridge by a set date.
a plan to speed up the work on the bridge.
an organised effort to guide visitors to the river.
a series of news reports about the bridge work.
questions.answer_support: volunteers handed out maps, put directions outside the station and led short guided walks
questions.target: campaign 概括具体宣传行动，promise 表示承诺
questions.skill: campaign 概括具体宣传行动，promise 表示承诺

exp.trans: 小镇承诺按期开桥，工程后来延期。另一项导路活动受到欢迎，志愿者发图、贴指示并带路。游客调查发现这组活动帮助人们找到河边。
exp.structure: 第一段区分承诺、施工和一系列导路动作。第二段对比获关注多的日期与真正帮助游客的活动。
exp.other: fall behind schedule 进度落后，hand out 分发，coverage 新闻报道。
exp.meaning: campaign 概括志愿者进行的持续性宣传与导路活动。
exp.rest: 通桥日期是 promise。工程进度是背景。新闻重点报道日期，报道并非这些志愿者活动的主体。

questions.passage:
A regional archive spent two weeks collecting family photographs at a summer festival. The exhibition that followed attracted large crowds, but a survey found that most visitors had come to look for people they knew. Few went on to use the archive's other collections.

The project had a different effect in a town whose photographs were poorly represented in the archive. Volunteers there used street directories to identify the locations of old photographs. The archive added those names to its online catalogue, so researchers could find the images by street after the exhibition closed. The archive had considered sending the exhibition to local schools, but the plan was dropped when transport costs rose.
questions.q: Which benefit continued after the exhibition closed?
o: Local schools still hosted the collection.
Researchers could locate photos by street.
Festival visitors kept donating photographs.
Volunteers continued collecting street directories.
questions.answer_support: researchers could find the images by street after the exhibition closed
questions.target: 区分短期热度和持续收益
questions.skill: 区分短期热度和持续收益

exp.trans: 节庆展览吸引了许多人，但多是来找熟人的。志愿者为老照片查明拍摄地点，档案馆把街名编入线上目录；展览结束后，研究者仍可按街道检索。
exp.structure: but 限定观展热度的含义；第二段 so 引出长期结果；after 明确持续时间。
exp.other: street directory 街道名录；catalogue 目录；drop a plan 放弃计划。
exp.meaning: 持续的是照片的检索能力，而不是有人继续办展或收集资料。
exp.rest: 学校巡展被取消；原文没说节后继续捐照片；志愿者查阅名录以识别地点，没说他们继续收集名录。

process-stage-role.skill: 区分结果核验、消息公开与实施授权
process-stage-role.q: A hospital trial finds that a scheduling tool reduces missed appointments. The methods panel accepts the results after checking the analysis, and a staff newsletter reports the trial. Routine use must nevertheless wait for the operations board to approve a staffing plan. Which event authorises the hospital to start using the tool routinely?
o: Acceptance of the trial analysis by the methods panel.
Publication of the trial results in the staff newsletter.
The operations board's approval of the staffing plan.
The trial team's observation of fewer missed appointments.

exp.trans: 一家医院的试验发现，一种预约安排工具减少了爽约。方法审核小组检查分析后认可了结果，员工通讯也报道了这项试验。不过，常规使用仍须等待运营委员会批准人员配置计划。哪个事件授权医院开始常规使用该工具？答案是人员配置计划获批。
exp.structure: A hospital trial + finds + that从句给出试验发现；The methods panel + accepts + the results说明核验阶段。Routine use + must wait + for the operations board to approve a staffing plan说明实施仍受另一项决定约束。nevertheless连接结果已获认可与尚不能常规实施的转折。
exp.other: scheduling tool 预约安排工具；miss an appointment 爽约；methods panel 方法审核小组；staffing plan 人员配置计划；authorise 授权。
exp.meaning: 题目问开始常规实施的授权条件。独立核查在本文确实发生，却只让研究结果获得认可，不能替代运营委员会的实施批准。不能把所有过程题都机械答成独立验证。
exp.rest: 审核小组认可的是试验分析，不是常规使用的授权；员工通讯负责传播消息，没有审批权；试验团队观察到效果是提出采用建议的证据起点，仍未满足文中保留的实施条件。

process-stage-role.skill: 按提问定位过程中的决定而非总选最后一步
process-stage-role.q: A technician noticed an unusual label on a food shipment and asked a supervisor whether it should be checked. The supervisor marked the shipment 'hold', stopping dispatch. A laboratory later found the contents safe, and the quality manager signed the release form. Which event directly stopped the shipment from leaving?
o: The technician's request for advice about the label.
The supervisor's decision to put the shipment on hold.
The laboratory's conclusion that the contents were safe.
The quality manager's signature on the release form.

exp.trans: 技术员发现一批食品的标签异常，询问主管是否应检查。主管将这批货标为暂扣，停止发运。实验室后来确认货物内容安全，质量经理签署了放行单。哪个事件直接阻止了货物运出？是主管作出的暂扣决定。
exp.structure: The technician + noticed ... and asked ...是发现和上报；whether it should be checked是询问内容，其中should be checked为被动谓语。The supervisor + marked + the shipment + hold，后接stopping dispatch说明结果。found the contents safe为find加宾语和形容词补语；signed the release form属于后来的放行阶段。
exp.other: shipment 一批货物；put on hold 暂停、暂扣；dispatch 发运；release form 放行单；contents 所装物品。
exp.meaning: 先确定题目问的是停止发运，而非最早发现异常、确认安全或最终放行。直接产生停运结果的是主管的暂扣决定。过程角色题必须按问题定位阶段，不能一概选最后的正式批准。
exp.rest: 技术员询问是否检查，是上报起点，文中实际停运由主管决定；实验室认定安全发生在之后，支持解除疑虑；经理签放行单允许后续运出，与停止运出方向相反。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

if-not-for-scope.passage:
A regional film archive could let researchers view its oldest newsreels online if it were not for the fact that several donors still allow the recordings to be shown only on site. The staff have digitised the reels and checked that the files play on ordinary computers. For now, visitors must make an appointment to see them in the archive.

An agreement covering remote viewing would open the collection to researchers who cannot travel. The archive has begun asking the donors whether they would agree to such a change.
if-not-for-scope.q: What currently prevents the archive from offering online viewing?
o: Some of the old newsreels have not been digitised.
The existing agreements limit where the films may be shown.
The archive has stopped allowing researchers to see the reels.
Most visitors cannot play the files on their own computers.
if-not-for-scope.answer_support: several donors still allow the recordings to be shown only on site
if-not-for-scope.target: 从 if it were not for 识别现实阻碍
if-not-for-scope.skill: 从 if it were not for 识别现实阻碍

exp.trans: 地方电影档案馆已经把新闻片数字化。现行许可只准在馆内播放，故目前观众须预约到馆。档案馆正争取远程观看许可。
exp.structure: 主句 could let 描述本来可行的事。if it were not for the fact that 引出当前阻碍。that 从句里的 still allow 保留肯定，许可范围由 only on site 限定。
exp.other: newsreel 新闻短片，digitise 数字化，on site 在现场，remote viewing 远程观看。
exp.meaning: 现有许可限制的是播放地点。若没有这一限制，在线提供新闻片就具有可行性。
exp.rest: 数字化与普通电脑播放测试已完成。到馆预约仍开放。文本没有说明多数访客的电脑不能播放。

synonym-reference.target: 用同义词承接已出现的时段
synonym-reference.skill: 核对回指对象及其在后续动作中的作用
synonym-reference.passage: Needing space for study groups, a college considered opening another room. The bookings office discovered that three rooms were already vacant for short periods after regular classes ended. The empty slots were too brief for a full lecture, but long enough for a tutoring session. Advisers began reserving these openings for students who wanted help between classes. As the rooms could still be used for teaching at other times, the college was able to run the study groups without adding classrooms.
synonym-reference.q: What did the advisers reserve for the students?
o: Spare places in the regular college classes.
Short intervals in the existing room schedules.
New rooms set aside for meetings and lectures.
Breaks taken by students during their lectures.
synonym-reference.answer_support: The empty slots were too brief for a full lecture, but long enough for a tutoring session.

exp.trans: 学院原想增开教室，但管理人员发现现有的三间教室在正常课程结束后会短暂空着。空档不够上一整节课，却够安排一次辅导。导师预订这些时段，学院因此可以不增设教室。
exp.structure: short periods、empty slots 和 these openings 三处连起来，指向教室课表上同一批空档。最后一句交代利用空档后的结果。
exp.other: vacant（空着的）、slot（时段）、tutoring session（辅导课）、reserve（预订）。
exp.meaning: 导师预订的是正常课后现有教室可用的时段。
exp.rest: 常规课堂的座位、增设的教室和听课中的休息时间都不是这几段可预订的空档。between classes 写的是学生何时来接受辅导。

cling-climb.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 攀爬
固守
批评
修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: 攀爬对应climb，不是cling to规则的比喻；批评和修改是对规则采取改变的态度，语境却说仍不愿放弃旧规则。
